summary: Small JavaScript library that takes a JSON scene of flat-shaded pseudo-3D shapes and returns a static SVG from any rotation without a DOM; a SMIL turntable variant and an MCP server exist. Zdog-like look an agent can write without code. Not yet exercised in VCR.
use_when: Flat Zdog-style icons from a JSON scene, lighter than Three.js
avoid_when: Use heerich for voxel scenes with validated SVG output
Use Three.js for interactive 3D, shading or animation
